messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty triggered -> High error rate and network packet loss observed from POP ap-southeast-3 (CDN edge). Symptoms: elevated 5xx, TCP retransmits, and client-side timeouts. Severity: P1. Pager: ryan_oncall. Incident ID INC-18001. Links: https://observability.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-18001

ryan_oncall: On it. Any quick scope? Which services impacted?

carla_sre: Seeing 5xx rate > 6% last 5m for text-gen and embedding endpoints with origin traces pointing to ap-southeast-3 edge nodes. Latency p95 jumped from 120ms -> 900ms. Edge metrics show packet loss on egress to ISP peer.

maya_netops: Confirmed BGP flaps to peer ASN 64512 in ap-southeast-3. Looking at our edge-router logs: repeated withdraws for /24 block 203.0.113.0/24. Sample: ```
Apr 12 03:14:02 rtr1 bgp[1234]: UPDATE: withdrawn 203.0.113.0/24
Apr 12 03:14:04 rtr1 bgp[1234]: UPDATE: announced 203.0.113.0/24 via peer isp-x
```

maya_netops: Also tcpdump from edge shows 25-30% packet loss to ISP next-hop across multiple nodes.

james_infra: Opened ticket with CDN provider (TKT-12345). They confirm peering congestion on their side and are investigating. Asked them to enable immediate traffic steering to backup POPs.

cdnpub-support: We see congestion on provider fabric for ap-southeast-3. Initiating emergency steering to ap-southeast-1 and ap-southeast-2 for affected prefixes.ETA for changes: rolling over next 60s-5m. Applying route-maps now.

ryan_oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) Ask CDN to steer traffic away from ap-southeast-3 (in progress). 2) Prep DNS fallback: lower TTL and point heavy customers to nearest healthy POP if steering not sufficient. 3) If CDN steering fails, enable our emergency egress via direct transit in ap-southeast-1. Notify customers.

carla_sre: Running quick smoke checks post-steer: `curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/health --resolve api.redwood.ai:443:203.0.113.10` shows 502 -> now seeing 200 for some nodes. Still intermittent.

zoe_csm: Heads up to CS: two enterprise customers (AcmeApps, BrightLearn) reported degraded responses. I'll open comms and send initial note with next update in 15m.

maya_netops: CDN provider pushed new next-hop and we see BGP steady for last 90s. Packet loss on affected links reduced from 28% -> 4% on sampled nodes.

cdnpub-support: Steering succeeded for ~78% of affected traffic. Remaining 22% on old paths due to ISP caches; working with peer to clear.

james_infra: Temporary rule applied to our edge LB to prioritize healthy upstreams for the next 30m: ```
route-policy emergency-steer {
  match prefix-set ap-sg-prefix
  set next-hop 198.51.100.5
}
```

ryan_oncall: Good. Start collecting impact numbers for post-incident: request loss %, customer list, and duration. Carla, can you calc percent of total requests affected?

carla_sre: Quick calc from traces: ~1.9% of total requests globally, 15% of traffic in ap-southeast-3 was impacted. Will run full query and paste results.

zoe_csm: Sent targeted note to AcmeApps + BrightLearn: initial ack + ETA 30m. Will escalate if they report severe degradation.

maya_netops: ISP peer reports clearing queues, no more withdraws for past 6m. Monitoring BGP and tcpdump.

cdnpub-support: Marking provider mitigation as complete on our side, keeping traffic steer for 20 more minutes for safety.

ryan_oncall: Preparing timeline and initial RCA (network blip -> peering congestion -> route oscillation -> packet loss -> CDN steering mitigated). Will hand off to day-shift for full RCA.

lee_runtime: Taking handoff at 1800103600. I will keep monitoring until stable and coordinate with maya and cdnpub-support for final wrap.

ryan_oncall: Thanks — handing to lee_runtime for post-mitigation tracking. Leaving remediation notes in INC-18001. :white_check_mark:

lee_runtime: Logged follow-up actions: 1) Validate cache-warm after steering, 2) schedule peering review with ISP-X, 3) run synthetic traffic tests across ap-southeast POPs for 24h. Adding to ENG-OPS board.

zoe_csm: Customer update sent: we mitigated the routing issue, customers may see intermittent errors for the last ~20min, full RCA forthcoming.

incident-bot: Incident INC-18001 status changed -> mitigated (manual). Postmortem requested. Link: https://observability.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-18001/postmortem

lee_runtime: Will draft postmortem and include timeline, root cause, and action items. Closing thread once postmortem in docs. :memo:
